verdict.rationale: Zep's concepts docs list a first-party "Custom Entity/Edge Types" feature that uses Pydantic-like classes to customize how entities and relations are created and retrieved. Graphiti's GitHub README adds that it supports "prescribed and learned ontology". An older HN thread in which developers said custom schema support was not yet implemented predates these docs and concerned RDF/OWL import, so it does not concretely contradict the current feature. Missing for 10: in-depth documentation of how to define and register custom types, details on ontology scope and limits, and independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an ml-engineer, I can customize the memory schema — entity types, edge types, or ontology — to match my domain

citations.quote: Custom Entity/Edge Types | Feature allowing use of Pydantic-like classes to customize creation/retrieval of entities and relations in the Context Graph.
support both prescribed and learned ontology
